fields.Name: IT80 - Agent Note Cache Types (entity_object invariant)
fields.Description: Pins the invariant behind the agent-context date-sort crash: a BaseEngine property configured as entity_object must hold real BaseEntity instances after a cross-server cache-change event, not the plain JSON objects the payload carries. NC1 fires a synthetic external cache-change event at AIEngine's _agentNotes config with string-dated plain rows and asserts every resulting row is a BaseEntity whose __mj_CreatedAt is a Date. NC2 runs the exact unguarded .getTime() sort that died in production over the post-event array. NC3 proves a malformed payload degrades to a database reload rather than poisoning the array. This tier is the only place the Date assertion is provable — the coercion lives in BaseEntity.Get()'s TSType handling and needs real EntityInfo field metadata that unit mocks do not build. 3 checks NC1-NC3.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: After an external cache-change event carrying plain JSON rows, AIEngine.Instance.AgentNotes holds BaseEntity instances whose __mj_CreatedAt is a Date with the payload's timestamps preserved; an unguarded .getTime() sort over that array is safe; a malformed payload falls back to a full database reload. Each check restores the engine via a forced Config(true) so the poisoned singleton cannot leak into later bundles.
